Subject: Capstone deliverable kickoff & reviewer rota

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for taking the interview loop with us last week. As discussed, I'm sending the capstone deliverable packet so you can get started. Please find the spec attached (redwood_capstone_spec_v2.pdf) and a small sample repo zip that contains the starter files we expect candidates to use.

Key details: 
- Deadline: Tue, Apr 27 11:59pm PT (submit by email as a single zip; see submission instructions below)
- Deliverable: short service prototype + README with design decisions (approx 3–5 hours expected)
- Submit to: hiring+submissions@redwood.ai with subject line: "Capstone Submission — Ethan Brooks"
- Reviewer window: reviewers will aim to finish reviews by Fri, May 1; we will schedule two reviewers per submission.

A couple of quick notes: we don't expect production-grade code — clarity of assumptions and tradeoffs matter more than polish. If you need to request a short deadline extension, reply here no later than Mon, Apr 26 end of day.

Attachments: redwood_capstone_spec_v2.pdf, sample_repo_structure.zip

Best,
Naomi

Hey Ethan —

Yes — stubbing the KV cache with a short write-up of expected behavior is totally fine. Focus on the API surface, latency tradeoffs, and a couple of example request/response flows. If you include a couple of microbenchmarks (even rough ones) that's a bonus but not required.

Monica and Aditya are cc'd — they'll be the primary reviewers. Monica will look at architecture and correctness; Aditya will focus on performance considerations and writeup clarity.

If anything changes on our side (reviewer availability / deadlines) I'll update the thread. Good luck and reach out if anything else pops up.

Best,
Naomi
